entries.1d43f059913d894d: This business franchises Mister Donut and Fujiya stores in Shizuoka and Aichi prefectures.
entries.21e85f88dc1fe2e6: The company and 1 consolidated subsidiary (Delica Shokuhin Co., Ltd.) make up the group. The parent company is AEON Co., Ltd., which holds 64.55% of the company's voting rights (as of February 28, 2026). Consolidated employees numbered 2,510 (fiscal year ended February 2026).
entries.26fce2b532abb710: A food supermarket company of the AEON Group, operating 249 stores in 7 prefectures including Shizuoka, Aichi and Mie.
entries.3718958747ec8227: This business franchises Mister Donut and Fujiya stores in Shizuoka and Aichi prefectures. Because its importance is too small to be classified as a separate reportable segment, it is combined with the Supermarket Business, and its amounts are not disclosed separately.
entries.37ef5602ca0d940c: It is positioned as the core company in the Tokai region within AEON Group's supermarket business. It has 249 stores in seven prefectures, including 109 in Shizuoka Prefecture, 61 in Aichi Prefecture and 48 in Mie Prefecture (as of February 28, 2026), concentrated in the Tokai region.
entries.386c494bc102e069: Revenue from sales of foodstuffs, daily necessities and other merchandise
entries.3c3402def3f988e5: A business model centered on the food supermarket “Maxvalu” in the Tokai region, with sales of foodstuffs and daily necessities as its main source of revenue.
entries.7b8d3a551b7afe46: Profit is what remains after deducting costs such as merchandise purchases, personnel expenses and store operating expenses from revenue.
entries.854556664640ddc9: This business operates food supermarkets "Maxvalu" and small stores "Maxvalu Express" in 7 prefectures: Shizuoka, Aichi, Mie, Gifu, Shiga, Kanagawa, and Yamanashi.
entries.8f88beb64ac57b42: Profit is what remains after deducting costs such as merchandise purchases, personnel expenses and store operating costs from revenue. Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥10,249 million.
entries.913ea77feaed3aca: [Business Description] states that it is the core company in the Tokai region of AEON Group's supermarket business, centered on pure holding company AEON Co., Ltd., and that it expands stores in seven prefectures, and [Principal Facilities] prints store counts by prefecture.
entries.9bfa6e87a0da2ebf: Sushi, cooked rice and prepared foods (Delica Foods)
entries.a415f9f89f5ab194: Calling products long loved in their regions and products made by local companies “jimono,” it holds events such as the “Jimono Product Grand Business Meeting” to discover and nurture them, advancing product development rooted in local communities. It is also expanding customer touchpoints beyond stores, including growing its cumulative total of mobile supermarkets to 43 and its unmanned “Max Mart” stores to a cumulative 200-store system.
entries.b23861b3d7d2351c: It sells fresh and processed foods and daily necessities at “Maxvalu” and its small-format store “Maxvalu Express.” It also carries AEON's private brand “Top Valu,” and its consolidated subsidiary Delica Shokuhin Co., Ltd. manufactures sushi, cooked rice, prepared foods and other products. Under other businesses, it also franchises Mister Donut and Fujiya stores.
entries.b6b165b8da1f3cb1: Local shoppers who use the stores
entries.bdbd66a8239e2a85: This business operates the food supermarket "Maxvalu" and the small-format "Maxvalu Express" in 7 prefectures: Shizuoka, Aichi, Mie, Gifu, Shiga, Kanagawa and Yamanashi. As of February 28, 2026, there were 249 stores, concentrated in the Tokai region, with 109 in Shizuoka Prefecture, 61 in Aichi Prefecture and 48 in Mie Prefecture. The consolidated subsidiary Delica Foods Co.,Ltd. manufactures sushi, cooked rice, prepared dishes and more. The Group has a single reportable segment, and operating revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥384,951 million.
entries.ca31d33366953576: Private brand "Top Value" and other products
entries.cad990b54765b5cb: Its main revenue comes from sales of foodstuffs and daily necessities in stores. Operating revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥384,951 million, up 2.0% from the previous year.
entries.f3e9923ff1ce3ab8: Its customers are local shoppers who buy everyday foodstuffs and daily necessities at its stores in seven prefectures, including Shizuoka, Aichi and Mie.
entries.f7ca9623605b6dfc: Under its medium-term management plan (fiscal 2024 to 2026), it sets three basic strategies: “transformation of the business structure,” “creation of added value through the use of technology,” and “promotion of sustainability management.” Under the brand message “Turning feelings into form, connected through ‘delicious,’” it is strengthening its stores through price appeal and an expanded assortment, including “Top Valu” products, and is introducing electronic shelf labels and self-checkout systems.
